verdict.rationale: Roles and permissions for collections are a fair question for an API client, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no such feature. Bruno is offline-only with 'No account. No login.' and relies on Git for collaboration, so any access control would come from the Git host, which is a host-platform workaround. License Administrator governance of Bruno AI (bruno-docs-60) is an adjacent control over AI providers, not over who can view or edit collections.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can control who can view or edit APIs and collections with roles and permissions
